translation: Took place in posad Serock, 8 May 1890, in the first hour after noon. Appeared personally Berek Koltun, cemetery attendant, 60[?], and Beniamin Rolinski[?], butcher, 44, residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at five[?] in the morning in posad Serock died a child of male sex named Chaim Lejb Rozenberg, son of Ruwel[?] and Cwetla[?] nee Endler [corrected in red from a struck-out form], the Rozenberg spouses, aged one year. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us; the witnesses declared themselves illiterate.
